name: day-planner
description: Your tasks, planned around your calendar.
author: Day Planner

scripts.start: pnpm --filter web build && node build.mjs && electron .
scripts.dist: pnpm --filter web build && node build.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.release: pnpm --filter web build && node build.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
